mapper.select: SELECT a.REL_NUMBER, a.REL_NAME, a.totalAmount REL_TRADE_AMOUNT, a.CERT_TYPE FROM (SELECT IFNULL(sum(IFNULL(REL_TRADE_AMOUNT, 0)), 0) totalAmount, REL_NUMBER, REL_NAME, TENANT_ID_, CERT_TYPE FROM ins_tra_funds WHERE DELFLAG_ = '1' AND STATUS IN ('6', '7', '8') AND (IS_ACCUMULATED = '0') AND (MAJOR_TRADE = '0') AND DATE_FORMAT(TRAN_DATE, '%Y') = #{param.year} GROUP BY REL_NUMBER UNION ALL SELECT IFNULL(sum(IFNULL(REL_TRADE_AMOUNT, 0)), 0) totalAmount, REL_NUMBER, REL_NAME, TENANT_ID_, CERT_TYPE FROM ins_tra_business WHERE DELFLAG_ = '1' AND STATUS IN ('6', '7', '8') AND (IS_ACCUMULATED = '0') AND (MAJOR_TRADE = '0') AND (IS_TRADE_AGREEMENT = '0') AND SUBSTR(contract_Date, 1, 4) = #{param.year} GROUP BY REL_NUMBER UNION ALL SELECT IFNULL(sum(IFNULL(REL_TRADE_AMOUNT, 0)), 0) totalAmount, REL_NUMBER, REL_NAME, TENANT_ID_, CERT_TYPE FROM ins_tra_interest WHERE DELFLAG_ = '1' AND STATUS IN ('6', '7', '8') AND (IS_ACCUMULATED = '0') AND (MAJOR_TRADE = '0') AND DATE_FORMAT(TRAN_DATE, '%Y') = #{param.year} GROUP BY REL_NUMBER UNION ALL SELECT IFNULL(sum(IFNULL(REL_TRADE_AMOUNT, 0)), 0) totalAmount, REL_NUMBER, REL_NAME, TENANT_ID_, CERT_TYPE FROM ins_tra_service WHERE DELFLAG_ = '1' AND STATUS IN ('6', '7', '8') AND (IS_ACCUMULATED = '0') AND (MAJOR_TRADE = '0') AND (IS_TRADE_AGREEMENT = '0') AND SUBSTR(contract_Date, 1, 4) = #{param.year} GROUP BY REL_NUMBER) A WHERE A.TOTALAMOUNT > 0 ORDER BY A.TOTALAMOUNT DESC
